notes_for_editor: Thin sourcing: the history rests mainly on LighthouseFriends (copyrighted; paraphrased, one short quote), which cites the Journal of the House of Assembly and Molloy's First Landfall (not read). The Marine branch corpus hits for Cape St. Mary are Nova Scotia's (Cape St. Mary, Digby County), not this station. Parks Canada DFHD pages return only a placeholder; the HistoricPlaces.ca statements were used instead. Conflicts: concrete encasement (mid-1950s per LF vs 1925 per federal heritage building statement); dwellings (1959/1963 per LF vs 1965 per register); Houlihan/Houlahan spelling; 1918 medal for 25 years vs 1894-1921 tenure. Collins's assistant start year approximated from first lighting. The 1881 lantern-fittings sentence cites 'the lantern' loosely; check. The 2015 heritage lighthouse designation comes from the station record, cited loosely to source 2 (statement for the heritage lighthouse). No wrecks found. Newspapers not searched (Newfoundland papers not in Chronicling America). Verified 2026-10-27: removed the unsourced 2015 heritage-lighthouse claim, the weather attribution, and the builder's name; moved 1869-1966 works into Building the light (no keeper-ending or storm material to justify those chapters); cut a second long LF quotation.
